en: Moments ago, tech giant Nvidia announced
zh: 剛剛，科技巨頭 NVIDIA 宣布，

en: it is reinstating Jensen Huang as president and CEO.
zh: 將讓黃仁勳復任總裁暨執行長。

en: He is also returning to the chip maker as a board member.
zh: 他也將回到這家晶片大廠擔任董事。

en: Just this month, Huang resigned as the company's boss
zh: 就在這個月，黃仁勳辭去了公司的領導職務，

en: when it emerged he had an affair with a suspected Chinese spy.
zh: 起因是外界得知他與一名疑似中國間諜的人士有染。

en: In a statement, the board's chair, Harvey C. Jones, says in part,
zh: 董事長 Harvey C. Jones 在聲明中表示，

en: "The board believes Jensen is the right person to lead Nvidia
zh: 「董事會相信黃仁勳是帶領 NVIDIA 的合適人選，

en: and that his reinstatement is in the best interest of
our stockholders, employees, partners, and customers."
zh: 股東、員工、夥伴與客戶的利益。」

en: The statement also includes a comment from Huang, who says in part,
zh: 聲明也附上黃仁勳的談話，他說：

en: "I take this responsibility with the greatest
zh: 「我以最謙卑的態度承擔這份責任，

en: Above all, I am grateful for the love and support of my family."
zh: 最重要的是，我感謝家人的愛與支持。」
